concerns.spots: Reviewers describe blemishes and picked-at spots looking visibly smaller, less scabbed, or gone overnight to within a couple of days; a few say results were less dramatic or that they hadn't used the patches long enough to judge recovery yet.
concerns.redness: The most consistently praised effect: redness and inflammation from popped, picked or extracted spots is repeatedly said to fade overnight or within a day or two.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers with skin-picking disorder or dermatillomania say the patch physically stops them from touching the spot and protects the healing wound, though one reviewer had a patch pull off a forming scab when removed.
concerns.dehydration: A couple of reviewers say the patches keep the spot hydrated and reduce flaking as it heals; not widely discussed otherwise.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the patches stayed on even on oily/greasy skin; not otherwise addressed.

extraits.texte: So they do help recovery. I've found as someone with a severe picking issue (litt√©ral holes in my skin bad) that pimple patches in general help me with picking, as the change in texture from skin reminds me that I'm picking and helps me to stop. But any patch does that, and the harsher edges of the stars sometimes actually bring more discomfort to cause picking. As for actual repair, in my experience, these seem to do pretty well in reducing redness, irritation, etc. But again, for me, most patches do that. I've found these don't stick as well as other patches. I normally use just some basic hydrochloride patches from my local grocery store, and those can stay on my face for days even with my persistent face touching. Whereas the star patches came off within the first evening I tried them. To be fair I also have a hairy face, and a bit of a unibrow where I get a lot of my spots, so it is difficult to find a patch that can still get to the damage through my fuzz. I think a main issue for the staying power is that the prongs of the stars snag easier, but it's still not good. In conclusion, I don't really recommend these for practical use, if you're really against the look of other patches, then sure, just know that these don't stick very well. Especially for my fellow hairy people.

These work well and they stay on. However, the star shape is counterintuitive to its function. Because the edges are pointed they leave gaps in between where the skin is not receiving treatment. Also, the edges can fold over and stick to themselves rendering the seal ineffective. I will be buying round or square patches in the future.
These patches are the ONLY thing that helps to clear up the redness and leave me scar-free from my cystic acne. They provide me with SO much more confidence and they look cute lol ;)

The hydro-sta recovery patches are amazing! Whenever I feel a breakout coming or notice irritation, I put one on and by the next morning the spot looks significantly reduced. They're gentle on the skin, yet really powerful at calming redness and swelling. I like that the patches are thin enough to wear during the day if needed, and they blend in pretty well under light makeup. The purple packaging is super cute and makes them easy to spot in my drawer. These stars have given me a lot of confidence because I don't feel the need to pick at blemishes anymore. Instead, I just pop one on and let it work its magic. They've really become a staple in my routine.

The Hydro-Star Recovery patches are amazing when my skin needs extra care. Whenever I accidentally pick at a spot or my skin feels dry and irritated, these stars really help calm everything down. They protect the area, reduce redness, and help the skin heal faster. I also love the ingredients like aloe and licorice root ‚Äî my skin always feels smoother after using them. Plus they're cute, which somehow makes the healing process feel better ✨

My daughter and I absolutely love these! They're the perfect size and stay stuck even if your skin is greasy. This was my first time buying the purple ones, but they work just as good as the black, blue, yellow, & clear ones! Absolutely best pimple patches I've ever used! Plus purple is my daughter's fav color!
These keep my spots hydrated and promote healing so I don't have to deal with flaky skin as my acne heals.

reserve: Reviewers rarely state a specific skin type (oily, dry, combination, sensitive, normal, mature); most identify instead by a behavioral concern (skin picking/dermatillomania) and by acne severity, so type-based segmentation is thin.
